criteria.description: Cute cat sitting serenely on the sand with distinct ears, tail curve, posture and golden eyes or rim lighting looking toward the horizon.
criteria.look_for: Cat body, head, triangular ears, curved tail, paws, facial features/eyes or silhouette, facing the sunset.

criteria.description: Vibrant sunset sky with multi-stop gradient (deep navy to warm violet, coral, golden orange) transitioning into calm ocean with sun reflection.
criteria.look_for: Multi-colored sky gradient, horizon line, ocean with glistening water reflection, glowing sun near the horizon.

criteria.description: Warm sandy beach in the foreground with gentle contours, shoreline meeting the ocean, subtle texture or gentle waves.
criteria.look_for: Sandy ground layer with warm golden/tan tones, transition line between wet sand and water.

criteria.description: Atmospheric evening details such as distant flying birds, faint evening stars in the upper sky, and radiant sun glow.
criteria.look_for: Silhouetted birds in flight, subtle stars/sparkles in twilight sky, sun halo glow.
